title.from: CadencePolicy — channel caps (~3 LinkedIn/week, two hire one human)
title.to: NOTE not a type — postingSchedule is channel config (was CadencePolicy)

description.from:
Parked config/rule spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

## CadencePolicy

Channel caps. **Not a type that ships every week** — a config/rule issue.

## Default

- About **3 LinkedIn slots/week**
- Mix: **two hire, one human**
- X (Twitter) cadence unspecified; do not invent a Discord cadence
- Timezone: America/New_York

Publicist governs what gets queued against the cap. Ryan approves before queued.

## Out of scope

- Not a weekly-shipping Kanbus type
- No auto-enqueue to fill the cap
- No Discord channel
description.to:
**Not an issue type.** Closed as a note. Publicist accepted 2026-09-01 campaign-ops list.

CadencePolicy is dropped. Defaults (~3 LinkedIn slots/week, two hire one human, America/New_York) become **`postingSchedule` config on the channel**, not a work item agents claim.

Do not re-open as a Kanbus type. Do not ship a weekly CadencePolicy object.
